mentions.name: Exercise video collage summarizer
mentions.description: This tool takes a video of an exercise, workout, or dance as input and outputs a single collage image summarizing it. It was chosen as a small-scope problem while the team hardens larger internal tools, and is expected to be released in about a month. Most of the work has gone into handling codec and ffmpeg behavior edge cases rather than computer vision tuning.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Input: video of an exercise/workout/dance. 
Output: single collage image as summary.
mentions.author: escapecharacter
